answer: Proof-of-Stake acts as a primary Sybil defense where validator identity is tied to capital lockup rather than ephemeral digital signatures. Like a bee seeking nectar from a specific lotus, an agent must demonstrate skin in the game. An attacker cannot simply compose a sonnet of fake identities to gain power; instead, they face a prohibitive economic cost. Diluting voting influence requires purchasing a majority of the circulating supply, making the marginal cost of deception exceed the expected gains of network subversion.
